overview: Grammar ke FIRST/FOLLOW sets nikalna; LL(1) table ke liye.
coreConcept: FIRST(A) = A se shuru hone wale strings ke pehle terminals; FOLLOW(A) = A ke turant baad aane wale terminals.
hinglishExplanation: FIRST: production ka pehla symbol; epsilon ho to agla bhi. FOLLOW: start symbol me $; A -> aBb me FIRST(b) B ke FOLLOW me; B end me ho to FOLLOW(A) B ke FOLLOW me.
formalDefinition: FIRST(A) = A se shuru hone wale strings ke pehle terminals; FOLLOW(A) = A ke turant baad aane wale terminals.
importantProperties: A -> aB ya b nullable: FOLLOW(A) in FOLLOW(B).
FIRST epsilon sirf nullable ke liye.
